plain: To decide how much someone must pay, such as a tax, and charge it to them

webster.text: To set, fix or charge a certain sum upon one, as a tax; as, to assess each citizen in due proportion.

example.quote: The present mode of assessing the continental tax is regulated by the extent of landed property in each state.
example.cite: Letters of Agrippa I-XI, Massachusetts Gazette, Nov. 1787-Jan. 1788
